name: SVG document
responsibility: Wraps a painted body in one self-contained document with its faces
description: Wraps the painted SVG with fonts, markers, slab and port gradients, theme tokens and the near/far stylesheet. The one shared chip moves and scales; both layers of words move on a shared baseline and fade over one span with complementary opacity. Reduced motion cuts the swap.

outgoing.label: each token's value, for a picture that stands alone
slabDefinitions: shared sheen gradient
outgoing.description: document.ts svgDocument adds slabDefinitions(palette) to its defs. The standing hatch was removed; slabs keep their group face.

outgoing.label: portDefinitions: well and fade gradients
outgoing.description: document.ts svgDocument includes portDefinitions(palette) in its defs.
